sources.title: Terminus2049 GitHub commit history for the archived interview
observations: GitHub API records a GitHub-signed, verified commit that added the archive file with a committer timestamp of 2020-03-10 05:23:09Z (13:23:09 China time).

A line-level comparison of that initial 201-line file and the 195-line version at the later 06:13:34Z commit found observed changes in front-matter formatting/image_feature metadata, markup wrappers and whitespace; no changed prose line was detected by this comparison.
limitations: The timestamp bounds the repository commit, not the original Renwu publication time and not necessarily the first time any copy existed online.
The comparison is between two versions inside the Terminus repository, not between Terminus and yyrw.org.cn or the unavailable original WeChat page.

A verified GitHub commit signature authenticates the commit object under GitHub's verification scheme; it does not independently authenticate the truth of the interview text or the identity of every upstream source.

sources.title: China Digital Times English disclosure of March 10 media directive
observations: CDT says it acquired and verified a collection of directives and presents 11 items labelled March 10, 2020.
The relevant instruction says not to place this type of report on home pages and to remove it if present; the yyrw article appears in the reference links.
CDT cautions that wording may not be exact, some instructions may be local or sector-specific, and the displayed date may be when the directive leaked rather than when issued.
limitations: This is a later disclosure, not the original signed directive or a recipient/receipt record.
The Chinese and English CDT pages are one disclosure lineage, not independent original evidence.
Exact issue time, recipient, scope and execution are not authenticated.

sources.title: China Digital Times Chinese disclosure listing the yyrw article URL
observations: The Chinese page labels the item 2020-03-10 and quotes 涉发哨人，此类报道不上首页，如有请撤下。
Its reference list names 吹哨子的人 and gives the same yyrw article URL with tracking parameters.
limitations: Same CDT disclosure lineage as AF15; not an independent original directive.
The English explanation warns that the date may be a leak date rather than issue date; wording and scope may be uncertain.
Does not prove the title change or homepage-link disappearance was caused by this instruction.

sources.title: 〖404文库〗人物｜发哨子的人 — China Digital Times
observations: CDT page title is 〖404文库〗人物｜发哨子的人 and the page displays 2020年3月10日.
The page contains an 原文 link whose href resolves to https://www.21join.com/index.php?a=show&c=index&catid=9&id=2703&m=content.
CDT editor note says: 该文原文已被删除 由合传媒备份存档.
The page itself displays the interview text and bylines 文|龚菁琦, 编辑|金石, 摄影|尹夕远.
The page was directly read through the public web page retrieval; the same URL returned HTTP 403 to the GitHub Actions requests client during attempted automated text comparison.
limitations: This is a CDT-hosted derivative archive, not the original Renwu WeChat bytes.
The He Media attribution is CDT's editorial statement and is not an independently authenticated chain-of-custody record.
The linked 21join URL is labelled 原文 by CDT but has not yet been successfully fetched or authenticated.
The text may be dependent on the He Media backup and must not be counted as an independent original edition.

sources.title: 21join URL labeled 原文 by CDT's Ai Fen 404 archive
observations: The hyperlink text 原文 on CDT page AF17 points to this exact 21join URL.
A direct page retrieval attempt through the web page tool returned a cache-miss error; this is not evidence that the origin server is offline.
A new Wayback CDX and archived-capture inspection has been added to the reproducible historical audit.
A Wayback CDX exact-URL query found one 2020 capture (20200312004223); that archived page returns HTTP 200 and contains the interview body indicators.
A domain-level CDX query (2020–2026, HTML/200, URL contains id=2703) returned three records: one article page and two api.php?op=count&id=2703&modelid=1 endpoint captures.
limitations: No body, server metadata, author identity or publication timestamp has yet been inspected at this URL.
CDT's label 原文 is a source attribution, not independent authentication that this URL is the original Renwu publication.
Do not infer the relationship between 21join and He Media beyond the attribution displayed by CDT.
The two additional domain-level records are count-endpoint captures, not additional article-body editions; only one article page capture is confirmed.

sources.title: Wayback capture of 21join page 发哨子的人 | 合传媒
observations: The exact 21join URL linked as 原文 from CDT's 404文库 page has one 2020 CDX record with status 200 and mimetype text/html.
The archived page returns HTTP 200 and its HTML title is 发哨子的人 | 合传媒.
The archived page body is 9,376 characters after HTML text extraction and contains the interview-opening phrase, 艾芬, and the bylines 龚菁琦 and 金石.
The page text also contains 合传媒.
Archived response SHA-256: f6a8b96e7be9b83dbeb4a7e61f9ef5302c770a6219dc3e4b9d4e27db26a031a3.

A reproducible three-source CI comparison found its extracted normalized body identical to the pinned Terminus text across all 200 sentence-like units; this is content equality, not proof of source independence.
Additional page metadata: keywords include 中国、武汉、疫情、吹哨人、艾芬; description begins with the interview's closing reflection; og:title begins 发哨子的人 - 民声.

The raw archived HTML response SHA differed across repeated retrieval runs, while the extracted normalized article-body SHA remained constant; raw wrapper fingerprints and article-body identity are therefore tracked separately.
A broader domain-level CDX query returned two additional 200 HTML captures of the site's api.php?op=count endpoint for id=2703; these are not article-body captures.
limitations: The Wayback capture establishes an archived 200 HTML representation at the capture time; it does not independently authenticate who operated the source page or its exact original publication time.
CDT's editorial note attributes its preserved copy to He Media, and this 21join page title contains 合传媒; this is consistent with that attribution but is not a separate independent edition.
This page must not be counted as independent of the CDT 404 reprint in assessing source independence.
No causal relation between the 21join copy and the yyrw homepage link disappearance is established.
Raw response hash variation may reflect archive wrapper/response changes; it is not evidence that the underlying archived article body changed.
The two count-endpoint captures are not independent article copies and do not establish readership or page-view counts without interpreting their response payloads.
